newsitem.title: USA: Fed seen adding reserves via multi-day system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed seen adding reserves via multi-day system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve was expected to inject reserves into the banking system on Monday via a round of system repurchase agreements.
Analysts said the term is up in the air but that the RPs would be multi-day rather than overnight, with three-day syetem RPs (for fixed collateral) the most likely scenario.
The Fed stayed out of the open market on Friday.
In early trading, federal funds were at their 5-1/2 percent target rate.
